description: This file contains utility functions for mapping status categories and strings to specific color values, intended for consistent visualization themes in a dark-background context. Functions include deterministic color generation from strings and status-based color mapping with predefined theme tokens.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel hue HSL color string from an input string, ensuring distinct colors for different strings while maintaining suitable saturation and lightness for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps input status strings to theme-defined colors for known statuses; defaults to a deterministic color for unknown or unspecified statuses, with special styling for 'unknown' or 'null' states.
